subject: ela
name: English Language Arts
course: Informational Analysis, Textual Evidence & Persuasive Writing
title: Grade 7 English Language Arts: Informational Analysis, Textual Evidence & Persuasive Writing
overview: Grade 7 English Language Arts cultivates analytical reading of complex literature, rhetorical dissection of informational texts, evidence-based argument composition, and public academic discourse.
competencies: Cite comprehensive textual evidence to analyze central ideas, themes, and author viewpoints.
Evaluate the credibility, reasoning, and rhetorical strategies of diverse informational texts.
Craft well-organized, defensible argument and informative essays with precise citations.
Communicate effectively in collaborative academic presentations and structured seminars.

modules.title: Literary Craft, Conflict & Point of View
modules.description: Analyzing how an author develops point of view, examining multiple perspectives, and exploring structural drama and poetry.

topics.title: Character Motivation & Complex Plot Conflicts
topics.description: Analyzing how contrasting points of view create suspense, humor, or dramatic tension.

topics.title: Poetic Forms and Structural Sound Devices
topics.description: Examining rhythm, alliteration, figurative imagery, and structural stanzas in modern and traditional poetry.

modules.title: Informational Text Analysis & Evaluating Evidence Quality
modules.description: Delineating an author's argument, evaluating whether claims are supported by sufficient and sound evidence.

topics.title: Tracing Central Claims and Supporting Details
topics.description: Evaluating how an author structures an argument and distinguishes key claims from supporting tangents.

topics.title: Evaluating Author Reasoning & Potential Bias
topics.description: Assessing whether reasoning is sound and identifying irrelevant evidence or biased framing.

modules.title: Persuasive Argument Writing & Multi-Source Research
modules.description: Crafting persuasive argumentative essays with formal counterclaims, clear warrants, and standard citations.

topics.title: Drafting Counterclaims & Persuasive Essays
topics.description: Writing essays acknowledging and refuting counterclaims using objective academic tone.

topics.title: Synthesis Research Papers with In-Text Citations
topics.description: Synthesizing evidence from multiple databases, evaluating source credibility, and quoting responsibly.
